package main

import (
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"example.com/plusminus/cmd"
)

//go:embed invocations.json
var invocationManifest []byte

func TestPlusMinusManifestErrors(t *testing.T) {
	var cases []struct { Args []string; Kind, Flag, Path string; Cause bool }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(invocationManifest, &cases); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	for _, tc := range cases {
		if tc.Kind == "" { continue }
		root, err := NewRoot("app", "dev", "none", "unknown")
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		err = root.Execute(tc.Args)
		var usage *cmd.UsageError
		if !errors.Is(err, cmd.ErrUsage) || !errors.As(fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", err), &usage) || string(usage.Kind) != tc.Kind || usage.Flag != tc.Flag || usage.CommandPath != tc.Path || (usage.Err != nil) != tc.Cause { t.Fatalf("%v: %#v error=%v", tc.Args, usage, err) }
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusTokenizer(t *testing.T) {
	option := func(key string) plusMinusOption { return plusMinusOption{Key: key, Boolean: true} }
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{"a": option("alpha"), "b": option("beta")}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"ab": option("ab")}
	for _, tc := range []struct { token string; keys, values []string; boundary, terminated, help bool }{
		{"+ab", []string{"alpha", "beta"}, []string{"false", "false"}, false, false, false},
		{"-ab", []string{"alpha", "beta"}, []string{"true", "true"}, false, false, false},
		{"--ab", []string{"ab"}, []string{"true"}, false, false, false},
		{"--ab=false", []string{"ab"}, []string{"false"}, false, false, false},
		{"word", nil, nil, true, false, false},
		{"+", nil, nil, true, false, false},
		{"-", nil, nil, true, false, false},
		{"--", nil, nil, false, true, false},
		{"-h", nil, nil, false, false, true},
	} {
		token, err := tokenizePlusMinus(tc.token, "app", short, long)
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		var keys, values []string
		for _, operation := range token.Values { keys = append(keys, operation.Option.Key); values = append(values, operation.Value) }
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(keys, tc.keys) || !reflect.DeepEqual(values, tc.values) || token.Boundary != tc.boundary || token.Terminated != tc.terminated || token.Help != tc.help { t.Fatalf("%s: %#v", tc.token, token) }
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusBoundariesAndAtomicClusters(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{"a": {Key: "alpha", Boolean: true, Set: func(string) error { calls++; return nil }}}
	for _, args := range [][]string{{"+az"}, {"-az"}, {"-ah"}, {"+a=value"}} {
		calls = 0
		if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus(args, "app", short, nil); err == nil || calls != 0 { t.Fatalf("partial cluster changed state: %v calls=%d error=%v", args, calls, err) }
	}
	subcmds := map[string]bool{"child": true}
	for _, tc := range []struct { prefix string; sub map[string]bool; start int }{
		{"child", subcmds, 0},
		{"--", nil, 1},
	} {
		args := []string{tc.prefix, "+childOnly", "--label=+a"}
		before := append([]string(nil), args...)
		tail, _, terminated, _, err := parsePlusMinus(args, "app", short, nil, tc.sub)
		if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, before) || !reflect.DeepEqual(tail, before[tc.start:]) || &tail[0] != &args[tc.start] || terminated != (tc.prefix == "--") { t.Fatalf("boundary changed argv: %v -> %v (%v)", args, tail, err) }
	}
	interspersedTail, seenInter, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"word", "-a"}, "app", short, nil)
	if err != nil || !seenInter["alpha"] || !reflect.DeepEqual(interspersedTail, []string{"word"}) {
		t.Fatalf("interspersed: tail=%v seen=%v err=%v", interspersedTail, seenInter, err)
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"label": {Key: "label", Set: func(s string) error { if s != "+a" && s != "val" { t.Fatalf("value rewritten: %q", s) }; return nil }}}
	if _, seen, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--label=+a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || !seen["label"] { t.Fatalf("attached value: %v %v", seen, err) }
	if _, seen, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--label", "+a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || !seen["label"] { t.Fatalf("separate plus value: %v %v", seen, err) }
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--label", "--verbose"}, "app", short, long); err == nil { t.Fatalf("expected error for flag-like separate value") }
}

func TestPlusMinusConversionAndErrors(t *testing.T) {
	value := 7
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"count": {Key: "count", Set: func(s string) error { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); if err == nil { value = n }; return err }}}
	_, seen, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=0"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err != nil || value != 0 || !seen["count"] { t.Fatalf("conversion: %d %v %v", value, seen, err) }
	for _, tc := range []struct { args []string; kind cmd.UsageErrorKind; cause bool }{
		{[]string{"--count"}, cmd.UsageMissingFlagValue, false},
		{[]string{"--count=bad"}, cmd.UsageInvalidValue, true},
		{[]string{"--missing"}, cmd.UsageUnknownFlag, false},
		{[]string{"++a"}, cmd.UsageUnknownFlag, false},
	} {
		_, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus(tc.args, "app nested", nil, long)
		wrapped := fmt.Errorf("caller: %w", err)
		var usage *cmd.UsageError
		if !errors.Is(err, cmd.ErrUsage) || !errors.As(wrapped, &usage) || usage.Kind != tc.kind || usage.CommandPath != "app nested" || (usage.Err != nil) != tc.cause { t.Fatalf("typed failure: %#v %v", usage, err) }
		if tc.cause { var number *strconv.NumError; if !errors.As(err, &number) { t.Fatal("lost conversion cause") } }
	}
	ioError := errors.New("I/O acquisition")
	long["input"] = plusMinusOption{Key: "input", IO: true, Set: func(string) error { return ioError }}
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--input=file"}, "app", nil, long); err != ioError || errors.Is(err, cmd.ErrUsage) { t.Fatalf("I/O error reclassified: %v", err) }
}

func TestPlusMinusNonbooleanOperations(t *testing.T) {
	currentCount := 7
	opt := plusMinusOption{
		Key:               "count",
		SupportsBarePlus:  true,
		SupportsValuePlus: true,
		StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { currentCount = n; return nil }, nil
		},
		StageBarePlus: func() (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { currentCount = 7; return nil }, nil
		},
		StageValuePlus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { currentCount += n; return nil }, nil
		},
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"count": opt}

	// 1. Long minus with value
	currentCount = 0
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=10"}, "app", nil, long); err != nil || currentCount != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("--count=10 failed: %v count=%d", err, currentCount)
	}

	// 2. Bare plus reset
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count"}, "app", nil, long); err != nil || currentCount != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("++count reset failed: %v count=%d", err, currentCount)
	}

	// 3. Assigned plus operation
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count=3"}, "app", nil, long); err != nil || currentCount != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("++count=3 failed: %v count=%d", err, currentCount)
	}

	// 4. Unsupported bare plus rejected
	unsupportedBare := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"count": {Key: "count", SupportsBarePlus: false, SupportsValuePlus: true},
	}
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count"}, "app", nil, unsupportedBare); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for unsupported ++count")
	}

	// 5. Unsupported assigned plus rejected
	unsupportedValue := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"count": {Key: "count", SupportsBarePlus: true, SupportsValuePlus: false},
	}
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"++count=5"}, "app", nil, unsupportedValue); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for unsupported ++count=5")
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusShortValueForms(t *testing.T) {
	aActive, bActive := false, false
	nVal := 0
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "a", Boolean: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { aActive = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
		"b": {Key: "b", Boolean: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { bActive = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
		"n": {Key: "n", Boolean: false, StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { nVal = n; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}

	// Separate: -n 5
	aActive, bActive, nVal = false, false, 0
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-n", "5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-n 5 failed: %v n=%d", err, nVal)
	}

	// Attached without '=': -n5
	nVal = 0
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-n5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-n5 failed: %v n=%d", err, nVal)
	}

	// Attached with '=': -n=5
	nVal = 0
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-n=5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-n=5 failed: %v n=%d", err, nVal)
	}

	// Cluster with attached value: -abn5
	aActive, bActive, nVal = false, false, 0
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-abn5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || !aActive || !bActive || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-abn5 failed: %v a=%t b=%t n=%d", err, aActive, bActive, nVal)
	}

	// Cluster with attached '=': -abn=5
	aActive, bActive, nVal = false, false, 0
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-abn=5"}, "app", short, nil); err != nil || !aActive || !bActive || nVal != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("-abn=5 failed: %v a=%t b=%t n=%d", err, aActive, bActive, nVal)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusSingleCharLongNamespace(t *testing.T) {
	shortCalled, longCalled := false, false
	short := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "short-a", Boolean: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { shortCalled = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{
		"a": {Key: "long-a", Boolean: true, StageMinus: func(string) (func() error, error) {
			return func() error { longCalled = true; return nil }, nil
		}},
	}

	// -a triggers short
	shortCalled, longCalled = false, false
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"-a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || !shortCalled || longCalled {
		t.Fatalf("-a failed: short=%t long=%t err=%v", shortCalled, longCalled, err)
	}

	// --a triggers long
	shortCalled, longCalled = false, false
	if _, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--a"}, "app", short, long); err != nil || shortCalled || !longCalled {
		t.Fatalf("--a failed: short=%t long=%t err=%v", shortCalled, longCalled, err)
	}
}

func TestPlusMinusAtomicCommit(t *testing.T) {
	stagedVal := 10
	opt := plusMinusOption{
		Key: "count",
		StageMinus: func(v string) (func() error, error) {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() error { stagedVal = n; return nil }, nil
		},
	}
	long := map[string]plusMinusOption{"count": opt}

	// First option valid, second option invalid conversion -> stagedVal remains unchanged
	_, _, _, _, err := parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=99", "--count=invalid"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err == nil || stagedVal != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("atomic commit failed: val=%d err=%v", stagedVal, err)
	}

	// First option valid, second option unknown flag -> stagedVal remains unchanged
	_, _, _, _, err = parsePlusMinus([]string{"--count=99", "--unknown"}, "app", nil, long)
	if err == nil || stagedVal != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("atomic commit failed: val=%d err=%v", stagedVal, err)
	}
}
